title: Status page moves to incident.io
body_markdown:
status.supabase.com now runs on incident.io's status page. The URL is unchanged.


Email subscribers were resubscribed automatically. If you subscribed through SMS, Slack, webhook, or RSS, those subscriptions did not carry over. Resubscribe at[status.supabase.com](https://status.supabase.com/) . The new platform supports only Email, RSS, and Slack, so SMS and webhook notifications are no longer available.


Email subscribers can now subscribe to the specific Products and Regions that matter most to them, so they only hear about incidents that affect them.
